definitions.explanation: A graded level in a system of ranking — used for beef, wine, hotel rooms, paychecks, insurance, and judo/karate. Implies an ordered scale with clear criteria, distinguishing top grades from lower ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{等級|とうきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the grade of the meat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}→自動車保険：26400_jidoushahoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{等級|とうきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My car insurance rating went up (a grade).

examples.japanese: ⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{等級|とうきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Wagyu beef is finely graded based on the marbling of the fat.

notes:
Compound of {等|とう} (class) + ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ (grade). The reading is とうきゅう (be careful: the homophone ⟦{投球|とうきゅう}→投球：15510_toukyuu⟧ means "pitching").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {等級|とうきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧/⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: a grade goes up/down
- {等級|とうきゅう}{分|わ}け: classifying by grade
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{等級|とうきゅう}: the highest grade
- {等級|とうきゅう}{制度|せいど}: grading system
- A5{等級|とうきゅう}: A5 grade (top wagyu grade)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{格付|かくづ}け→格付け：13121_kakuzuke⟧: rating; ranking — emphasizes the act of evaluating
- ⟦ランク→ランク：24405_ranku⟧: rank — borrowed from English; more casual
- ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧: grade (single character) — used in martial arts and tests ({1|いっ}{級|きゅう}, {2|に}{級|きゅう})
- ⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧: class; rank — military or social class
